Northern Trust Appoints Jennifer Immel as Regional Wealth Advisor for West Florida. Northern Trust Corporation announced that it has appointed Jennifer Immel as regional wealth advisor for West Florida. In her new role, Immel will work with client service teams to provide wealth planning solutions for ultra-high net worth clients across the region. She will be based in the Naples Parkshore office, Florida. Immel, who has over 30 years of wealth planning experience, has previously served as director of Wealth Planning for the state of Florida for PNC Wealth Management and prior to that as its senior wealth planner.

Northern Trust Announces Redemption of Series C Preferred Stock. Northern Trust Corporation announced the redemption on January 1, 2020 (the “Redemption Date”), of all 16,000 outstanding shares of its Series C Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, $25,000 liquidation preference per share (the “Series C Preferred Stock”), and the corresponding redemption of all 16,000,000 outstanding depositary shares (the “Depositary Shares”), each representing a 1/1,000th interest in a share of Series C Preferred Stock. The Depositary Shares will be redeemed at a redemption price of $25.00 per Depositary Share. Such redemption price does not include the regular quarterly dividend of $0.365625 per Depositary Share that was previously declared and will be paid on the Redemption Date in the ordinary course to holders of record as of December 15, 2019. On and after the Redemption Date, the Series C Preferred Stock will no longer be deemed outstanding, and no further dividends will be declared or payable on the Series C Preferred Stock.

Northern Trust and BondEvalue Partner to Deliver Fractionalised Bond Ownership Using Blockchain Technology. Northern Trust and BondEvalue announced a strategic partnership to deliver integrated asset servicing and digital solutions for fractional ownership of fixed income bonds. BondEvalue’s regulated platform will facilitate trading of fractionalised investable assets based on wholesale bonds, while Northern Trust will be its exclusive asset servicing provider. BondEvalue’s platform combines the power of blockchain-based distributed ledger technology (DLT) to enable enhanced transparency and liquidity, while making institutional grade investment opportunities available to new classes of investors. The Memorandum of Understanding between Northern Trust and BondEvalue was signed on 5 November 2019.

Northern Trust Wealth Management Appoints Steph Wagner as Senior Wealth Strategist and Director of Women & Wealth, Based in Austin. Northern Trust Wealth Management has appointed Steph Wagner as a Senior Wealth Strategist and Director of Women & Wealth, based in Austin. In addition to advising high-net-worth families in central Texas on investment, banking and wealth management strategies, Wagner will be responsible for leading the firm’s advisory practice around women in transition. She most recently served as the Managing Director and Co-Founder of Sendero Women and Wealth, a division of the registered investment advisory firm based in central Texas. Prior to that, she built a national consulting practice as a financial strategist for high-net-worth women in transition and was the Founder & CEO of Women Wealthy Wise in San Diego.

Northern Trust Expands into Philadelphia; Announces Key Hires. Northern Trust announced that Michelle Hong and Melissa Novak, CFA, will co-head the firm’s local team and newly opened office in Philadelphia, providing wealth management services for clients in the Pennsylvania area. Both Hong and Novak will report to Mid-Atlantic Region President Brett Rees. Northern Trust opened its Philadelphia location at 2400 Market Street in October 2019. The expansion demonstrates the firm’s commitment to the market where it has served clients for many decades, and builds on its strong presence in the Mid-Atlantic region. Hong joins from Brown Brothers Harriman, where she managed assets for more than 200 clients as a Senior Vice President of Private Banking. Prior to Brown Brothers Harriman, Hong was an associate at Morgan, Lewis & Bockius, where she counseled clients on state, federal, and international tax issues, estate planning, philanthropic giving, and managing private foundations. Novak will be a Senior Vice President at Northern Trust and on the Mid-Atlantic Investment Leadership Team. She joins from Hawthorn, PNC Family Wealth®, where she was Senior Vice President and Senior Investment Advisor, managing in excess of a billion dollars for a select number of families and individuals.

Northern Trust Announces Appointment of Executives. Northern Trust announced the appointment of two senior business development executives to its Global Foreign Exchange Solutions practice in North America. David Byne and William Hartnett will be responsible for driving growth across the full range of FX solutions at Northern Trust, including algorithmic trading, CompleteFX™ (outsourced end-to-end FX dealing service), and Currency Management. Hartnett, based in Chicago, has more than a decade of foreign exchange experience, serving in several trading and sales roles before transitioning to business development. Prior to Northern Trust, Hartnett served as an FX options trader on the Chicago Board of Trade and at Fifth Third Bank. Byne brings almost 15 years of foreign exchange experience to Northern Trust. Before joining Northern Trust, Byne held a number of FX-related positions at Credit Suisse and Citi, among others.
